compactRecord.rs: One of the few places in Japan you can walk freely among wild native horses on dramatic coastal grasslands.
compactRecord.td: Southern tip of Miyazaki's Nichinan coast: grassy headlands where ~100 semi-wild Misaki horses — a Japanese Natural Monument since 1953 and one of only eight native Japanese horse breeds — graze year-round amid lighthouse views over the Pacific.
